في جولة صيفية عبر 10 ولايات: On a summer tour across 10 wilayas
Ooredoo الجزائر تُقرّب العالم الرقمي من: Ooredoo Algeria brings the digital world closer to Algerians with the "Summer Tour 2026"
مواصلةً لالتزامها بالقرب من زبائنها وترق: Continuing its commitment to staying close to its customers and promoting digital usage, Ooredoo Algeria has launched its "Summer Tour 2026" summer tour, traveling through ten (10) coastal wilayas across the country, with the aim of providing the general public with an immersive experience combining connectivity, entertainment, e-sports, and the discovery of Ooredoo's solutions and services.
تتواصل هذه الجولة من 16 جويلية إلى غاية: This tour runs from July 16 to September 8, 2026, stopping at a number of beach areas, waterfronts, public squares, and entertainment venues that see heavy foot traffic during the summer season, allowing Ooredoo to connect directly with the public and deliver an experience centered around connectivity, entertainment, and innovation.
تُنظم جولة Summer Tour 2026 بالشراكة مع: The Summer Tour 2026 is organized in partnership with Condor and Ifri, and revolves around an immersive digital village designed as a space for discovery, interaction, and entertainment through e-sports and digital uses, while giving visitors the opportunity to learn about Ooredoo's products and services.
عبر مختلف محطاتها، تجوب الجولة الصيفية ع: Across its various stops, the summer tour will notably travel through Marsa Ben M'hidi in the wilaya of Tlemcen, the Seddikia district in Bir El Djir, Oran, Mostaland in Mostaganem, Les Sablettes beach in Algiers, the Boumerdes waterfront, the port square of Tigzirt in Tizi Ouzou, the 5 July 1962 square in Bejaia, as well as other venues in Jijel, Skikda, and Annaba, reinforcing Ooredoo's close presence in some of the most prominent summer destinations nationwide.
وبالإضافة إلى ذلك، تتضمن جولة Summer Tou: In addition, the Summer Tour 2026 also features a commercial and digital dimension, where visitors can take advantage of various activities and gifts when purchasing an offer or making a top-up of 500 DZD or more, or by following the Ooredoo Algeria TikTok page.
من خلال هذه المبادرة، تحوّل Ooredoo الجز: Through this initiative, Ooredoo Algeria transforms popular summer hotspots into true spaces for connection, experimentation, and discovery, offering an accessible and easy digital experience for vacationers, families, youth, and gaming enthusiasts in an interactive and friendly atmosphere.
عبر Summer Tour 2026، تجدد Ooredoo الجزا: Through the Summer Tour 2026, Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its ambition to place customer experience, proximity, and innovation at the core of its initiatives, leveraging digitization, entertainment, and connectivity as levers for interaction and engagement during the summer season.
